introduction.en: NIMZs are large-scale, integrated industrial townships envisioned under the National Manufacturing Policy (2011) to transform India into a global manufacturing hub.
introduction.hi: NIMZs are large-scale, integrated industrial townships envisioned under the National Manufacturing Policy (2011) to transform India into a global manufacturing hub.

body.en: NIMZs provide world-class infrastructure, simplified regulatory processes, and single-window clearance to reduce the cost of doing business. By integrating industrial, residential, and social infrastructure, they create economies of scale. They are crucial for boosting the manufacturing sector's share in GDP and generating large-scale employment for the youth.

conclusion.en: NIMZs serve as a cornerstone for the 'Make in India' initiative, fostering a competitive industrial ecosystem that can drive sustainable economic growth.

valueAddition.en: NIMZs are designed to be self-contained with world-class infrastructure and land use planning.
